mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.certification_id, s.name, s.display_order, COUNT(q.id) AS question_count FROM subject s LEFT JOIN certification_question q ON q.subject_id = s.id AND q.deleted = 0 WHERE s.certification_id = #{certificationId} AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.id, s.certification_id, s.name, s.display_order ORDER BY s.display_order ASC
